title: the @16 step physics: P-DEV-@16 confirmed (the bytes rule), the routed-union histogram, the completion-stamp split
workload: bench_concurrent 16 streams (the standard bench; the 256-token prompts), the adopted config minus F2 (the boot_ts env), the measurement boot with the T1b instrumentation

bench.note: the historical @16 level REPRODUCED with the standard bench; the earlier-session 205-211 claim was the custom 512-token-script artifact (the ffb5495 lesson again) — corrected
bench.note2: the histogram bincount (42 D2H syncs/step) costs ~20% aggregate — the measurement-only cost

aip_util_load_window.rank_skew: mild (r1 21% / r7 26%); the expert placement is NOT needed

bytes_step_rank.basis: the deployed MoE op is a DENSE pass (every token x every local expert, masked; hpu_fused_moe.py:87) -> the 36-expert all-read is batch-independent: 38.1 GB experts + ~5.5 GB non-expert
bytes_step_rank.verdict: 43.6 >= 25 GB -> P-DEV-@16 (the T1b decision rule); Q21 is the master @16 lever
bytes_step_rank.effective_BW: 43.6 GB / 57 ms step = 0.76 TB/s = 31% of the 2.45 TB/s peak — the dense pass wastes BOTH the bytes (the un-routed experts) AND the compute (the masked row-expert ops: 40x36 vs the routed ~16x36 per layer)

routing_union_histogram.capture: 20 eager-phase steps (the graph replays do not execute the python hook — the hook recorded the capture/warm-up steps only; the routing distribution is execution-independent so the estimate holds)
routing_union_histogram.padding_note: the 40-row bucket carries 8 padding rows -> the union is an UPPER bound on the true routed union
routing_union_histogram.q21_model: 36 dense -> 16.1 union = 2.24x expert-byte cut; the expert term 38.1 -> 17.0 GB; the total 43.6 -> ~22.5 GB/rank/step

completion_stamp_split.caveat: the per-step torch.hpu.synchronize() serializes the pipeline (the real step 57-76 ms vs the stamped 115); the launch term absorbs the device-backpressure in the lazy mode — the split is directional: the host dispatch and the sampler host are ~half the step, the device drain ~26+ ms

next: L1 (the Q21 integration to the A/B) now carries the GB ground truth: the A/B must report the per-rank GB/step (the invariant) and the union histogram per arm; L4.0 (the MTP-ON @16 decomposition) is the next measurement
